citations.title: Install the command-line tool
citations.heading: Install
citations.snippet: Open PowerShell as an administrator and run: winget install Nibleaf.CLI Restart PowerShell so it finds the new command.

en-before.answer: Open PowerShell as an administrator and run `winget install Nibleaf.CLI`. [S1]
